tasks.title: Model pages and their versions
tasks.description: Add server/src/models/pageModel.ts (title 120, content 100k, depth 3, versions 20, slug/position/version/archived, both indexes) and server/src/models/pageVersionModel.ts (snapshot with the unique (page, version) index).

tasks.title: Write the pure slug and mention helpers
tasks.description: Add server/src/utils/pages.ts: slugify, uniqueSlug, extractTaskKeys with MAX_MENTIONS, snippetAround and escapeRegex.

tasks.title: Write the pure depth and move rules
tasks.description: Add depthOf, subtreeHeight, isSelfOrDescendant and canMoveUnder to server/src/utils/pages.ts so nesting limits and cycle prevention are decided without the database.

tasks.title: Cover the pure rules with unit tests
tasks.description: Add server/src/__tests__/pages.test.ts for slugify/uniqueSlug, task-key extraction, snippets, escaping and the depth/move decisions.

tasks.title: Implement listing, reading and searching
tasks.description: Add listPages (tree rows without content, optional project with a 404 for an unknown one), getPage (with creator/editor populated and resolved mentions) and searchPages (two-character minimum, escaped case-insensitive match, snippets) to server/src/controllers/pageController.ts.

tasks.title: Implement creation with slug and position rules
tasks.description: createPage: project resolution, parent membership and depth check, next sibling position, unique slug with a retry on a duplicate key, page.created activity.

tasks.title: Implement version-guarded editing
tasks.description: updatePage with the version check, the 409 answer carrying the latest page, the no-op shortcut, applyEdit (atomic findOneAndUpdate) and the snapshot/prune of the previous text, plus page.updated activity.

tasks.title: Implement move and delete
tasks.description: movePage (canMoveUnder, re-numbering of siblings, answers the whole tree) and deletePage (children move up one level, the page's versions are deleted, page.deleted recorded).

tasks.title: Implement the version history endpoints
tasks.description: listVersions (current version plus the newest twenty summaries), getVersion (one version with its content, 404 when unknown) and restoreVersion (the old text written as a new edit so the replaced text stays in history).

tasks.title: Declare the routes and the body limit
tasks.description: Add server/src/routes/pageRoutes.ts (protect once, then a permission per route, /search before /:id), mount it at /:slug/pages in server/src/routes/workspaceRoutes.ts and add the 400 kB JSON parser for that path in server/src/app.ts.

tasks.title: Cover the pages API with integration tests
tasks.description: Add server/src/__integration__/pages.test.ts: access, create/read/validation, nesting and moving, editing and conflicts, history, delete, projects, mentions, search and the audit trail.

tasks.title: Build the wiki API, types and hooks
tasks.description: Add client/src/features/wiki/{api,types,index}.ts and the hooks useWikiTree, useWikiPage and useWikiSearch, including the conflict result type that turns a 409 into { kind: 'conflict', page }.

tasks.title: Write the client tree and markdown helpers
tasks.description: Add lib/tree.ts (groupByParent, visibleRows, ancestorsOf, expandedToReveal, depthOf, heightBelow, planMove, canAddChild, summaryOf), lib/markdown.ts (wrapSelection, prefixLines, cycleHeading, insertLink, insertTaskKey, applyToolbarAction) and lib/mentions.ts (taskHref, mentionLinks, remarkTaskKeys, isExternalHref, isInternalHref, describeLastEdit).

tasks.title: Build the reader, editor and dialogs
tasks.description: Add MarkdownView (react-markdown + remark-gfm + remarkTaskKeys, heading shift, safe links, images as links), WikiDocument, PageEditor with the toolbar, ConflictDialog, VersionHistorySheet, TaskMentionPicker, NewPageDialog, WikiNav and WikiTree with keyboard move/indent.

tasks.title: Add the wiki screens and the project tab
tasks.description: Add client/src/pages/WikiPage.tsx (tree, page, editor, conflict, versions, delete) with lazy routes in client/src/App.tsx, and render ProjectWikiTab inside client/src/features/projects/components/ProjectWorkspace.tsx.

tasks.title: Cover the client wiki with tests
tasks.description: Add client/src/features/wiki/__tests__/{tree,markdown,mentions}.test.ts, MarkdownView.test.tsx and components.test.tsx for the tree helpers, toolbar edits, mention rendering and the components.
